mapper.select:
SELECT DD.출고사업장 AS dlivyBplc , DD.출고일자 AS dlivyDe , DD.출고일련번호 AS dlivySn , RTRIM(DD.출고품목코드) AS dlivyIcCode , DD.수량 AS qy , DD.구분 AS se , DD.출고단가 AS dlivyUntpc , DD.출고금액 + DD.부가세금액 AS dlivyDetailAm , COUNT(DD.출고일자) OVER (PARTITION BY DH.출고일자, DD.출고거래처) AS co , SUM(DD.수량) OVER (PARTITION BY DH.출고일자, DD.출고거래처) AS qySm , DD.비고 AS rm , DH.총금액 AS am , RTRIM(IC.품목명) AS icNm , RTRIM(IC.규격) AS icStndrd , RTRIM(CM.상호) AS dlvyEntrpsNm
, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DH.출고일자, DD.출고거래처 ORDER BY DD.출고일자 DESC,DH.출고거래처, IC.품목명) AS GRP_DTNUMBER , CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),DATEADD(DD,-4, #{listEndDt}),112) AS listEndDt
ORDER BY DD.출고일자 DESC, DH.출고거래처, IC.품목명
mapper.sql:
FROM 출고머리 DH JOIN 출고상세 DD WITH(NOLOCK) ON (DH.출고사업장 = DD.출고사업장 AND DH.출고일자 = DD.출고일자 AND DH.출고일련번호 = DD.출고일련번호 )
JOIN 거래처MASTER CM WITH(NOLOCK) ON (DH.출고사업장 = CM.등록사업장 AND DH.출고거래처 = CM.거래처코드)
JOIN 품목코드 IC WITH(NOLOCK) ON (DD.출고사업장 = IC.사업장 AND DD.출고품목코드 = IC.품목코드)
